titles.title: Figure in Black

description: Loosely painted watercolor on the upper half of the page.  An orange oval is in the center with an area of black around it, set in a ground of muddy brown.  The graphite drawing is visible and on either side of the orange area are two small pear-shaped loops.  This artwork has *Untitled (Leah)*, 1918 (cat. no. 241) on the back.
